exam_scheme.note: The Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) Entrance Tests are conducted by the Office of the Controller of Examinations, AMU, for admission into undergraduate (B.Tech at Zakir Husain College of Engineering & Technology, B.A. LL.B., B.Sc. Hons, B.Com. Hons) and postgraduate (M.Sc., MBA, MCA, LL.M.) degree courses. For the flagship engineering entrance examination (AMUEEE / B.Tech Entrance), the test comprises a single pen-and-paper OMR-based paper of 180 minutes (3 hours) duration containing 150 multiple-choice questions carrying 150 marks, equally distributed across Physics (50 questions, 50 marks), Chemistry (50 questions, 50 marks), and Mathematics (50 questions, 50 marks). For general departmental admission tests (B.A. LL.B., B.Com, B.Sc.), question papers carry 100 multiple-choice questions (100 marks) of 120 minutes duration. Marking scheme: 1 mark awarded for each correct response, negative marking of 0.25 marks deducted for each incorrect response (-0.25), and 0 marks for unattempted questions.
